name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-UAV
notes: Real, dependency-free coordination boundary for camera-equipped UAVs: a named high-level flight-request vocabulary (ARM/TAKEOFF/GOTO_WAYPOINT/HOVER_AND_CAPTURE/RETURN_TO_LAUNCH/LAND) gated through HYDRA-UMC-SDK's shared safety contract, a real, deterministic HeartbeatMonitor link-loss failsafe state machine, and a real MAVLink command sender (MavlinkFlightControl) mapping each request to its real, numbered MAV_CMD - only an already-gated dispatch is ever sent. ARM (renamed from the misleading PRE_FLIGHT_CHECK) requires the literal boolean confirm_arm is True (v0.0.6: never a merely-truthy value like the string 'false'); takeoff altitude and waypoint lat/lon/alt are validated as real, non-boolean, finite numbers within real geographic range before ever reaching a real COMMAND_LONG. Never computes flight control or stabilization itself; real-time failsafe execution stays the flight controller's own authority. Not yet exercised against a real flight controller or SITL.
